title: Aurelius wet-lab experimental results
description: Standardised format for feeding measured properties back into the oracle. Accepted by `aurelius ingest-experiment` as either this JSON envelope or a CSV with the same column names as the measurement fields.

source.description: Laboratory, notebook reference or publication the measurements came from.

date.description: ISO-8601 date the measurements were recorded.

smiles.description: SMILES of the measured compound. Canonicalised on ingestion; entries that RDKit cannot parse are rejected.

measured_property.description: Which property was measured. Only these are consumed by the oracle; anything else is recorded but ignored for refitting.

value.description: Measured value, in the units named by `units`.

units.description: Units of `value`. Checked against the expected units for `measured_property`; a mismatch is rejected rather than silently converted.

temperature_K.description: Measurement temperature in kelvin. Required because dielectric and viscosity are strongly temperature-dependent; the oracle models are referenced to 298.15 K.

method.description: Measurement technique, e.g. 'impedance spectroscopy', 'falling-ball viscometry', 'cyclic voltammetry'. Recorded for provenance.

uncertainty.description: Optional standard uncertainty on `value`, in the same units.
